verdicts.reason: A keeps the LUST/FOR/WIN lockup big and dominant across the banner height, but it adds stray '××' fragments beside the side crosses that read as accidental. Its corner marks are gone, the dot row is jammed near the bottom edge, and you can see vertical seam bands in the background photo. B shrinks the lockup into a small central island that looks like a scaled-down square. Its 'corner' x marks sit inset at the visible background seams instead of the canvas corners, which makes the panel artifact more obvious and leaves both sides as dead space.
